Not blocked.

(10,14)+(10,46): DOWN → (14,14) B → moves.

(6,30)+(6,38)?? The right eye is 38-41, the left eye is 30-33: rows 6-9, cols 30-33 = top of stripe → death. Can't be there.
So the blocked-movement candidates:
1. (6,6)/(6,54) + LEFT
2. (10,6)/(10,54) + LEFT
3. (14,6)/(14,54) + LEFT
4. (26,22)/(26,38) + UP
5. (14,22)/(14,38) + DOWN
6. (14,14)/(14,46) + DOWN
7. (14,18)/(14,42) + DOWN

8. (6,10)/(6,50) + UP
9. (6,14)/(6,46) + UP
10. (6,18)/(6,42) + UP

13. (10,6) + LEFT, (14,6) + LEFT, (26,6) + LEFT, (30,6) + LEFT, (34,6) + LEFT (rows 34-37, cols 2-5: B → moves, not blocked).
The rightmost column (x,54) + RIGHT → blocked (P cols 62-63):
14. (10,54), (14,54), (26,54), (30,54) + RIGHT.
Hmm, there are a lot of candidates. Which is most likely to be the "goal"?
In L1, the goal = the eyes are at the top row flanking the stripe + RIGHT (toward the stripe, blocked). The blocked direction was toward the central feature.
L2's central feature = the crack/stripe (26-33). Blocked moves toward it: (26,22)/(26,38) + UP (toward the top of the window? no, toward the window). Hmm, UP at (26,22) is blocked by the window, not the crack.
(14,22)/(14,38) + DOWN: blocked by the window.
What blocks toward the crack? The crack is at 26-29, rows 26-37. The eyes can't be adjacent to the crack without touching it (death). So a blocked move toward the crack is impossible.
Hmm, so in L2 the "blocked" trigger is probably at the edge of the board (M/P border) or at the window.

I've only tested SPACE at (18,6). Let me test LEFT at (18,6)/(18,54) (blocked by M) — the eyes are currently at (6,26).

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def eyes():
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sr=[r for r in range(64) if 'S' in lines[r]]
    r=sr[0]; cs=[c for c in range(64) if lines[r][c]=='S']
    return sr[0], min(cs), max(cs)
def test(name, act):
    action([act])
    print(name, act, 'level',current_frame.level,'done?',last_action_result.get('done'),'lc?',last_action_result.get('level_completed'),'changed?',last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
    if current_frame.level!=2 or last_action_result.get('done'): raise SystemExit
test('top row UP','UP')
action(['LEFT']*5+['DOWN']*3); print('pos',eyes())
test('window flank LEFT','LEFT')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
